quotes: Equation 2 is the unbiased Gini–Simpson form: it gives the probability that two draws without replacement differ.
The flip rate has a ceiling: $F\leq 1-1/k$, where $k$ is the number of claim classes.
contradictions.description: The stated ceiling conflicts with the without-replacement definition in Equation 2. For equally populated classes, that equation gives F = N/(N−1) × (1−1/k), which exceeds the stated ceiling for finite N.

contradictions.description: Table 3's caption labels its entries as selected through LLM interpretation, but the text identifies them as the five PCs shared across greedy selections. The table includes PC9 with score 3, which does not satisfy the interpretation-based selection requirement of the maximum score, 6, in both runs.
